name: Diffusion Gloss
summary: A smooth, over-detailed image with a perfect rim light, a teal and amber grade and a soft bokeh ground. It became the default look of text-to-image models from 2022.

philosophy.core_thesis: Everything is lit, sharp and finished: the model gives each surface the same expensive sheen, and the sheen is the style.
design_principles: Light the subject with a rim light of 2px to 6px width in amber (#F0A04B) against a teal haze (#1F8A99).
Smooth skin and surfaces to a pore size of under 1px, and add fine detail of 1px to 2px on hair, fabric and metal.
Place the subject on the upper-third line with a bokeh ground of 8 to 20 soft discs, 20px to 120px wide.
Raise contrast at the mid-tones and set a bloom of 12px to 24px around highlights.
Use a 4:5 or 16:9 frame at 1024px or more on the short side.
Add a short caption in 14px sans with the prompt words in lower case under the image.
Keep the colour grade at two hues, teal and amber, with one pink accent at 10%.
anti_patterns: Visible grain and flat, dull light
Messy, cluttered grounds with no focus

layout.grid_mechanics: A full-bleed hero image with a 12-column overlay grid and 24px gutters; the subject sits on the upper-third line.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 20% of the frame is quiet bokeh; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero subject and flush-left caption; text sits on a dark gradient scrim at the lower 25%.
layout.container_geometry: Cards with a 24px radius and a thin 1px light edge; pills with a full radius.

font_pairings.note: A clean geometric face for captions over a glossy image.
A wide, smooth sans with a friendly text face.

hierarchy_rules: Set the prompt words in lower case.
Keep text short and over the scrim.

color.palette_structure: A teal and amber complementary pair on a deep night blue, with one pink accent and a pale mist for text.
color.contrast_rules: Mist text on midnight holds at least 13:1; amber and teal carry rim lines, glows and buttons.
color.surface_treatment: A smooth gradient scrim; a bloom of 12px to 24px; a very fine noise of 2% to hide banding.
color.light_and_shadow: A strong rim light from behind at 30° to 60°, a soft key from the front and a warm bounce; shadows stay lifted.

materiality.surface_simulation: A lit studio render: wet skin, polished metal, silk and glass with the same sheen.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px edge in white at 12% on cards; images have no border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Bokeh blur of 8px to 24px on the ground; cards carry a soft shadow of 0 12px 32px at 40% black.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Filled icons at 20px with rounded terminals, white at 90%.
ornamentation_details.illustration: One heroic subject, such as a portrait, a robot or a fantasy city, with lens flare and bokeh.

motion.transition_physics: Images fade in over 600ms with a slow 1.04x push; a bloom pulses 3% for 4 seconds in a loop.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the glow by 8px and lifts the card 4px; active returns it.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels awe at the finish and, after a moment, doubt at its sameness.

use_cases: AI product pages and model demos
avoid_when: The brand needs honest, imperfect photography.
The page shows real products that must be exact.

modifiers.how: Remove the rim light and bokeh; use even, soft frontal light and one small fault.
Add a generic subject, a warped hand, false text and an engagement caption.
Use a stylised avatar pack with a violet glow ground.

pack.why: Filled icons in circles sit well over a dark gradient scrim and a glossy image.

ground.why: The ground is a soft teal and amber glow, like the haze and the rim light of the rendered images.
